info.name: ValueApi
info.description:
Read-only vehicle catalog and asking-price valuation API. No authentication is currently required by the Flask application. Start the API using src/api/README.md, then send requests to the local baseUrl. Change collection variables in Postman as needed; environment variables with the same names override them.

Run List makes first and copy an actual ID into makeId. Use Make details to choose year, make, and model values present in your imported catalog. Sample variable values are illustrative and do not guarantee matching data.

Catalog responses are cached per worker for 15 minutes by default. Database-dependent requests may return 503 when unavailable. Valuations may return 422 when there is insufficient evidence or calibration. Imports are CLI operations, not HTTP endpoints.

request.description: Returns {makes: [{id, name}]} in alphabetical order. Use an ID in Make details. Errors: 503 Catalog temporarily unavailable.

Returns {id, name, models: [{id, name, years: [{id, year, trims: [{id, name}]}]}]}. makeId must be an integer from List makes. Models, years, and trims can be empty. Errors: 404 Make not found; 503 Catalog temporarily unavailable.

request.description: Returns {countryCode: CA | US | null} using supported CDN country headers. Cloudflare takes precedence over Vercel. Without supported headers the result is null. Response uses Cache-Control: private, no-store. Enable one of the sample headers to simulate a hint locally; a deployed CDN may replace it.

Returns {locations: [{country, region}]} from recorded dealer data, sorted by region then country. Country may be null. Use these values for valuation filters. Errors: 503 Locations temporarily unavailable.

request.description:
Requires year, make, and model. Optional parameters are disabled initially; enable them in the Params tab. Enable mileage and mileageUnit together. Unknown or repeated query parameters are rejected. Currency defaults to USD; no currency conversion is performed.

Returns estimatedAskingPrice, currency, marketRange, referenceMileageKm, requestedMileageKm, mileageSource, confidence, comparables, valuationBasis, historicalReference, locationSelection, and listingSummary. Mileage in the response is kilometres. Location selection may fall back to a wider area; inspect locationSelection. valuationBasis is current, historical, or projected. Time projection is disabled by default. Confidence and market ranges are provisional, not statistical guarantees.

Errors: 400 {error} for invalid input; 422 {error: Insufficient evidence, reason, reasonCode} when the data/settings cannot support an estimate; 503 {error: Valuation temporarily unavailable} for database errors.
